# pele (vendored)

Pele 1.13.0 by kepano (MIT). Renders Mermaid text to SVG with no dependencies and no browser. Source: https://github.com/obsidianmd/pele, package `pele@1.13.0` on npm. `pele.js` is the unmodified `dist/pele.js` from that package (sha256 37bea5005aa6d2dde929032ced5d2958cf642667cbc1fe675f9dfacf4ba15a51). The LICENSE next to it is the package's own.

Used only through `../../scripts/render_diagram.mjs`. Needs Node 20 or newer. To update, replace `pele.js` and `LICENSE` from a newer npm package and rerun the render selftest.
